name: Name badge
description: A compact name tag for a corner: the name and a short line such as pronouns or role.

params.name: name
params.help: The person's name, e.g. Alex Kim

params.name: line
params.help: Short second line, e.g. pronouns (she/her) or role (empty: name only)

params.name: align
params.help: Which side of the box the tag sits on: left for a left corner, right for a right corner
